item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.100

  • Fixes Companion readiness checks so the bridge liveness endpoint stays responsive while Powerhouse voice-runtime warmup is running.
  • Keeps full Powerhouse/HF diagnostics on their dedicated status endpoints instead of making the basic bridge health check block on heavy runtime inspection.
  • Improves accuracy of status banners that previously could report local bridge timeout, stale Tailscale mapping, or old runtime while the current bridge was actually installed and warming.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.99

  • Supersedes the local 0.1.98 test package with the public GitHub/Appcast release line.
  • Adds the Powerhouse runtime manager for aggressive Companion Realtime Voice prewarming, runtime health checks, and priority-helper diagnostics.
  • Improves packaged HF runtime verification, Sparkle updater helper validation, and Companion readiness reporting.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.97

  • Adds Powerhouse preparation modes so the Companion can proactively warm local STT, local LLM, streaming TTS, route, and network paths.
  • Adds pooled HF speech-to-speech sidecars: the primary/default profile comes online first, then fallback STT profiles are warmed in parallel.
  • Adds an optional realtime priority helper so hot VoiceClaw sidecars and bridge runtime processes can receive elevated scheduling priority.
  • Improves Companion Realtime Voice diagnostics, runtime manifest verification, packaged-app validation, and interrupt-safe TTS streaming behavior.
